title.title: The equivariant Hikita conjecture for every finite quiver
title.subtitle: Claim: for any finite quiver, Higgs-branch cohomology equals functions on the Coulomb-branch fixed locus

plain: Two mirror-image spaces from physics: counting holes in one equals listing functions on the other

beats.text: A small quiver, schematically; the claim allows any finite quiver, loops and multi-edges too
Symplectic duality: cohomology on one side, functions on a fixed scheme on the other
Under a regularity hypothesis on the stability character

achievement.label: Hikita's conjecture (2017), equivariant form
achievement.context: Before: hypertoric cases, ADE quivers, some affine type A cases

verify.ourCheck: We graded the claim, not whether it is right

voice.text: Symplectic duality pairs a Higgs branch with a Coulomb branch.
Hikita: one side's cohomology equals functions on the other's fixed locus.
Claimed: true for every finite quiver, with a regularity condition.

sources.quote: Equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture for arbitrary finite quivers (loops and multi-edges allowed) under a regularity hypothesis on the stability character
Requires a regular stability character (free action on the stable locus); 41 pp, single paper. No Lean.
I graded what each family claims, not whether it is right.
